snippet.title: Metro Gravity Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's the link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986450/Metro_Gravity/ 

Yeah, so it's releasing Friday, June 20th 2025.

Thank you for all of your support this past year and a half! I can't believe I'm saying this, but I am actually releasing my first game. I never thought I'd get to say that. 

Also I'm releasing my first album! The OST will be out on streaming platforms the same day as release.

-mrkogamedev
